integrity: The claim is proved analytically from an exact Gaussian integral and positivity/convexity. Literature comparison is limited to the cited inspected sources and targeted searches; historical priority is not asserted beyond that comparison.
scientific_limitations: Simple null mean \(0\), known unit variance, Gaussian observations, and disjoint folds only.
Moment regularity does not imply power optimality; larger \(K\) can reduce power.
The supporting-information PDF for Tse and Davison (2022) was inaccessible in the inspected route; the main article identifies it as a variance derivation.
title: Sharp moment spectrum of Gaussian \(K\)-fold universal likelihood-ratio e-values
